data.gender_notes: Aina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ain' meaning 'to live'. This name signifies the one who is alive, lively, and full of energy. The name Aina carries the meaning “The Living One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aina usually hope their child will grow to embody the living one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aina represents the inner light of the soul and the beauty of the divine.
data.etymology: Aina belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Living One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aina total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
